This bean plot is very small, only a tiny piece behind the house, and I intercrop it with maize like I always do. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, but for beans on this small piece I do not buy a whole bag of urea — beans make their own goodness in the soil, and the little fertilizer I can afford I put on the maize plot. I will use seeds I saved from last season because they did fine, and I will spread some manure from our few chickens and goats. I weed myself with my daughter; the plot is too small to pay anyone.
